subject: Executive briefing: routing change request & per-diem reconciliation
messages:
From: Monique Harris <monique.harris@stellarus.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava Travel <ava@travelops.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec briefing travel - routing change request

Diego —

Quick note as we lock in logistics for the July 29 executive briefing: our CEO has an internal conflict with the late red-eye routing you proposed. She can only fly daytime and cannot do >6 hour overnight segments. Can you confirm whether Redwood can re-route the return on July 30 to avoid the red-eye?

If changing to a daytime connection increases cost beyond $600 extra per person, we will need a short note so our procurement can approve the variance on their side (they prefer cost-neutral). Attached is the current itinerary we received from Ava Travel.

Also flagging per-diem: our policy includes a city-specific per-diem for SFO; if Redwood is covering any meals beyond conference catering, we should reconcile before the event.

Thanks — appreciate a quick read.

Best,
Monique Harris
Director, Procurement
Stellarus Health

Attachments: stellarus-itinerary-v1.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ava Travel <ava@travelops.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec briefing travel - routing change request

Team —

FYI from Stellarus: CEO needs daytime routing on 7/30, red-eye not acceptable. Monique called out $600 as an upper tolerance from their procurement. Can TravelOps re-price daytime options and indicate incremental cost per person?

Requesting approvals for two items so operations can book:
- Company approval for premium daytime routing if incremental cost <= $900 per person (we've had precedent where customer covers partial).
- Finance approval to either absorb or invoice Stellarus for any delta depending on final number.

Soojin: can you confirm whether we can mark this as customer-billable under the Deal (DEAL-8842) if Monique's procurement agrees?
Marissa/Vivek: need quick sign-off on exceptions and whether we route this through corporate card or direct bill to customer.

I've looped Ava Travel to provide alternate itineraries and a cost spreadsheet; please keep responses tight — booking needs to complete by 7/1 to avoid higher fares.

Thanks,
Diego
Head of Enterprise Events
Redwood Inference

--- Forwarded attachment: stellarus-itinerary-v1.pdf ---
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ava Travel <ava@travelops.com>, Monique Harris <monique.harris@stellarus.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec briefing travel - routing change request

Diego / all —

I reviewed the routing alternatives from Ava Travel. Summary in attached cost-estimate-routing-v2.xlsx. Quick highlights:
- Option A (daytime single-stop return): +$720/person over baseline
- Option B (same-day with early morning connection): +$420/person over baseline but requires 2.5 hour layover and arrives later in the evening
- Option C (premium economy daytime non-stop when available): +$1,250/person (rare availability)

Policy/approval recommendation:
- We should offer Option B to Stellarus as the cost-effective daytime alternative. Since Monique's procurement said ~$600 cap, Option B at +$420 is within their note; if they want Option A, we request cost-share.
- Per-diem: Redwood will cover conference-day catering. Any ad-hoc meals outside of that will be invoiced to Stellarus under the travel allowance line (per-diem reconciliation required).

Billing guidance: Finance can invoice Stellarus for the incremental fare if they confirm in writing and provide a PO. If we need to absorb, please confirm immediately so we can use corporate card and then expense.

Approvals requested (reply-all with explicit yes/no):
1) Marissa: customer-billable routing delta OK if Stellarus confirms in writing?
2) Vivek: approve invoicing/cost allocation flow (we'd add line item to invoice or create separate travel invoice).
3) Kimberly: corporate card booking OK if we need immediate purchase prior to PO?

Soojin
Senior Events Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: cost-estimate-routing-v2.xlsx (excel, 45KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monique Harris <monique.harris@stellarus.com>, Ava Travel <ava@travelops.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec briefing travel - routing change request

Thanks Soojin —

1) Customer-billable routing delta: APPROVED if Stellarus provides written confirmation (email/PO) that they accept Option B (+$420/person). We'll add a single-line travel adjustment to DEAL-8842 and route through Finance.
2) Vivek: please confirm payment timing (invoice vs. credit card prepay). If Stellarus can provide a PO within 48 hours, we'll invoice and avoid corporate card use.
3) Kimberly: corporate card booking is fine as contingency, but keep receipts and upload signed-travel-waiver.docx to the expense submission.

Vivek — please reply with the exact GL string and invoice workflow (short snippet) so I can pass to Monique and expedite approval.

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Exec briefing travel - routing change request

Apologies for the slight delay — Finance confirms the following and this is approved: 

- GL code for travel pass-through: 5400-ENT-TRVL (use for deal DEAL-8842).
- If Stellarus provides a PO and signs off on Option B (+$420/person), Finance will invoice Stellarus on net-30; Redwood will not absorb the delta.
- If no PO by 7/1 and fares increase, use corporate card and expense to employee with "Customer travel prepay" tag; claim will be reconciled to the deal and invoiced to customer after we secure PO.

Action items:
- Soojin/Ava Travel: please confirm Option B fares for the four travelers and book using corporate card if we don't have a PO by 7/1. Upload signed-travel-waiver.docx with the booking record.
- Marissa: please add the travel adjustment line to the deal and note the GL code above.
- Diego: loop Monique for written confirmation of Option B so we have procurement sign-off.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
